name: Kroger Family of Companies Rewards World Elite Mastercard

localized_names.en: Kroger Family of Companies Rewards World Elite Mastercard

rewards.redemption_notes: Credit Card Points post to the Kroger Family of Companies rewards account and are redeemed under the Kroger Rewards Program terms.

notes: Issued by First Bank & Trust, Brookings, SD, and serviced by Imprint; replaces the U.S. Bank Kroger card. The rewards terms state maximum totals (including Kroger Rewards Program and Boost points) of 5X on Kroger digital channels, 4X at Kroger fuel pumps, 3X at other Kroger physical locations, 2X on dining, travel and utilities and 1X elsewhere; the card-only rate is in a table not readable as text, so base_rate is null. Annual fee not confirmed from an official page.
